notes: Norce orders whose utm_campaign matches no live Meta campaign (kept at market and tactic level, classified by name at detail level): KIR | SE+NO-BS-offers (53), KIR | SE NO-BS-offers (9).

Tactic = Meta's own audience segment: 'existing customers' is the customer audience set in the Meta account's audience settings; everyone else is 'prospecting' (new). Every ad set targets broadly, so campaign names cannot separate retargeting from prospecting.

Norce orders = orders whose GA4 session came from a paid Meta click (utm source facebook/instagram/fb/ig, medium cpc/paid), matched to Norce; new vs returning by the warehouse flag (no order in that market in the previous 365 days). Recent days are grossed up for orders not yet matched to GA4.
Norce knows the campaign, not the ad set: at detail level a campaign's orders are shared over its ad-set groups by Meta's purchases in the same segment.
Meta purchases are Meta's 7-day click / 1-day view count: it includes view-throughs and other devices, so it is the optimistic end of each range; Norce clicks are the conservative end.

Value: GP2 rate per market from the pacing section (Norce − BC returns − Norce COGS − shipping  pick & pack); 12-month repeat GP2 per new customer from customers acquired Nov 2024–Oct 2025 (repeat revenue capped at 20 000 SEK per customer); incrementality assumptions: new 0.6  existing 0.3.
Frequency is Meta's own period frequency (impressions ÷ unique reach) for the 7-day window and the month, by market and segment; at detail level it is impression-weighted over the group's ad sets.
